name: symbols
expected:
✧✦     the model the last turn ran on, then Jev's confidence in that pick
◔      the reasoning effort it ran at (Haiku takes none, so none is shown)

❐      the directory; left out when the worktree has the same name
      the git branch, cut with … when long; (detached) when none is checked out
⌂      the linked git worktree you are working in
≡      how much of the context window is used
☞      you picked the model with /model, so Jev leaves it alone
(why)  a reason in brackets after the effort, only when the pick is not the obvious one
new …  a newer model than the router was tuned for: run /jev-calibrate
